units.title: SG-4.1.2 Lock phaser to 3.90.x in package-lock.json
Act: Set root phaser specifier to ~3.90.0 in package-lock.json
Act: Update node_modules/phaser lock entry to 3.90.0
Verify: Lockfile root phaser specifier unit tests

tests.id: phaserLockfile.test.ts::lockfile root phaser specifier > root phaser specifier is ~3.90.0 and equals package.json
tests.name: root phaser specifier is ~3.90.0 and equals package.json
tests.title: lockfile root phaser specifier: root phaser specifier is ~3.90.0 and equals package.json
tests.scenario: Given the frontend package.json and package-lock.json on disk, when the root phaser specifier is read from the lockfile, then it is exactly ~3.90.0 and matches the package.json declaration.
tests.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/phaserLockfile.test.ts -t 'root phaser specifier' --testTimeout=20000
tests.detail: 1 passed in 3ms. Red-before-ACT1 inferred from the git diff ('^4.2.1' on HEAD), not re-run live.

units.title: Verify: Lockfile node_modules/phaser entry unit tests

tests.id: phaserLockfile.test.ts::lockfile node_modules/phaser entry::pins the locked phaser version to the 3.90.x line
tests.name: pins the locked phaser version to the 3.90.x line
tests.title: lockfile node_modules/phaser entry pins the locked phaser version to the 3.90.x line
tests.scenario: Given the frontend package-lock.json on disk, when the node_modules/phaser entry is read, then its version is 3.90.x.
tests.detail: Asserts version matches /^3\.90\.\d+$/. Fails against the 4.2.1 entry.

tests.id: phaserLockfile.test.ts::lockfile node_modules/phaser entry::resolves the tarball from the npm registry for the locked version
tests.name: resolves the tarball from the npm registry for the locked version
tests.title: lockfile node_modules/phaser entry resolves the tarball from the npm registry for the locked version
tests.scenario: Given the node_modules/phaser entry, when its resolved URL is read, then it points at the registry tarball for that exact version.
tests.detail: Asserts resolved equals https://registry.npmjs.org/phaser/-/phaser-${version}.tgz. Passes against 4.2.1 too, because it is self-consistent with whatever version is pinned.

tests.id: phaserLockfile.test.ts::lockfile node_modules/phaser entry::records a sha512 integrity hash that is not the 4.2.1 hash
tests.name: records a sha512 integrity hash that is not the 4.2.1 hash
tests.title: lockfile node_modules/phaser entry records a sha512 integrity hash that is not the 4.2.1 hash
tests.scenario: Given the node_modules/phaser entry, when its integrity is read, then it is a sha512 SRI value distinct from the old 4.2.1 entry.
tests.detail: Asserts integrity matches /^sha512-[A-Za-z0-9+/]+=*$/ and is not the 4.2.1 hash. Fails against the 4.2.1 entry.

tests.name: depends on eventemitter3 '^5.0.1'
tests.title: lockfile node_modules/phaser entry depends on eventemitter3 '^5.0.1'
tests.scenario: Given the node_modules/phaser entry, when its dependencies are read, then eventemitter3 is declared as '^5.0.1'.
tests.detail: Asserts dependencies.eventemitter3 is '^5.0.1'. Fails against the 4.2.1 entry (it has '^5.0.4').
